description: This file defines an interface named StoppedTimer, which extends the Timer interface. It provides method signatures for retrieving the duration, tags, and specific tag values of a stopped timer metric within a metrics collection system.

classes.name: StoppedTimer
classes.description: An interface representing a timer that has been stopped, providing methods to access its duration, tags, and specific tag values.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration for which the timer was active. Throws IllegalStateException if the timer has not been started and stopped properly.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a map containing all tags associated with this timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag identified by the provided key.
